Game changesWiki changes

Selected updates through 8 November 2026.

Updating a world
  • Back up your world before trying an older game version. Newer saves may not open in older versions.
  • Older worlds keep their original terrain. Very old worlds from before the smaller building grid are not converted.
  • Use matching game versions on the server and each player’s computer.
  • Older workshops remain in Worlds with their builds intact. Use blueprints to move a build to a new flat workshop.
  • Blueprints leave out doors and cannot include furniture. A blueprint using unsupported blocks may not load.

Saves and world files · Moving a build

8 November 2026

  • Added single and double beds with a choice of frame wood and bedding colour. Lie down to rest, alone or on a server, where two players can share a double bed.
  • Added a cooking stove you build from a furniture plan. Cook raw meat or venison with charcoal, in solo play or on a server.
  • Added floor, table and wall lamps that you switch on and off by hand. They need no fuel and stay as you left them after saving.
  • Fixed lanterns on furniture not lighting the walls and floor around them.
  • Improved performance when many lights and much terrain are in view.
  • Fixed a furniture move on a server turning into a new paid piece when someone else had moved the original first.
  • Fixed meals being lost on a server while lying in a bed with a blocked exit, and the host getting stuck in such a bed.
  • Added calls for 57 animal species, a short yelp when you hit one and a soft sigh when a blow kills it.
  • Fixed backing up the open world after hosting it, which could stop that world from loading again.
  • Fixed an open stove on a server needing to be reopened, move refusals being hidden, and door moves staying blocked.
  • Explosions, shells and tank tracks no longer knock the support out from under placed furniture in single-player worlds.
  • Added boat sounds at the helm: rushing water that follows your speed, sail flutter and an occasional creak.
  • Fixed queued crafts on a server being dropped when the server was briefly busy.
  • Fixed players near an unusual animal on a server being disconnected.
  • Fixed eating and drinking from the inventory while seated or resting.
  • Fixed bow shots using the previous shot's draw time.
  • Fixed a new world failing to load after a deleted world had used its path.

7 November 2026

  • Added windowed doors and separate style, wood and size choices for door recipes. The target card now shows a still picture.
  • Added moving whole closed doors in Creative, with undo and redo, also on servers. Middle-click copies a door's style, wood and size.
  • Added joining tables into larger dining tables, and a writing desk that joins end to end.
  • Added wardrobes, chests of drawers and a bookcase to store things in, and a wall shelf. Bookcases and shelves can show a red lantern.
  • Changed wardrobe and cupboard doors to swing open, and the top drawer to slide out, while you use their storage. Cupboard handles can have their own wood.
  • Added refinishing wooden chests with the furniture hammer. Choose new woods for the body, lid and fittings without emptying the chest.
  • Added putting lanterns on tables on servers, with undo and redo. Tables can now be moved with a lantern on them.
  • Fixed chest actions near the save size limit. An action that would make the world file too big is now refused before any items move.

6 November 2026

  • Added coffee tables and side tables. On servers, tables can now change their woods.
  • Added putting a red lantern on a table. Take it back with an empty hand, or undo it.
  • Changed furniture to block building and mining behind it. You can still reach through gaps such as between table legs.
  • Fixed dedicated servers confirming item, crafting, food, combat and building actions before they had been saved.
  • Fixed servers near the save size limit. Actions that would make the world file too big are now refused and keep your items.
  • Fixed F6 reporting a save when nothing had been written.
  • Fixed furniture paid for in Survival losing its refund after being moved by a Creative player on a server.

5 November 2026

  • Changed the menus to a warm stone-and-brass look, with masonry panels, brass highlights and wooden hotbar slots.
  • Added kitchen storage and chests for Creative players on servers. Only real carried items can be stored, not free catalogue items.
  • Added Home storage, setting up and packing up the Home crate, and resting for a world's owner on a Creative server.
  • Fixed dedicated servers confirming furniture changes and kitchen storage before they had been saved.
  • Fixed hosting your own world so your carried items and the world are saved together, and an interrupted save is finished on the next start.

4 November 2026

  • Added marble tops for kitchen counters and marble basins for sinks.
  • Added kitchen cupboards, wall cupboards, counter cabinets and sink cabinets with storage. Shift+right-click lines up kitchen pieces.
  • Added a washbasin, a toilet you can sit on and a bathtub, in clay, stone, marble or iron.
  • Added changing kitchen materials on servers, and undo and redo for Survival furniture you paid for.
  • Fixed dedicated servers confirming paid furniture placement before it had been saved.

31 October 2026

  • Added kitchen counters you place in runs, with a separate wood for the frame and the top.
  • Added storage in kitchen counters, including on servers. A filled counter keeps its items when moved, and counters can have a stone top.
  • Added kitchen sinks with stone basins. Drink from a sink or refill a flask at it.
  • Added sofa sections that join into longer sofas, and a corner sofa for L-shaped seating.

30 October 2026

  • Added stools and two-seat benches you can sit on.
  • Added armchairs and two-seat sofas with a choice of frame wood and cream, sage or rust upholstery.
  • Added sitting on furniture on servers. You stand at a clear exit when you leave a seat.
  • Improved water, with smoother shore surf and foam, more natural light through water, better shading of submerged walls and plants, and no haze over water.

29 October 2026

  • Added chests, Home storage and resting for Creative players on servers.
  • Added hanging and taking down doors, and fishing, in Survival on servers.
  • Fixed items being lost if a hosted world stopped during a save. Unfinished hand-overs are kept and finished the next time the world starts.
  • Fixed dedicated servers losing recent changes after an interrupted save. The last complete save is recovered on the next start.
  • Improved water, with less banding on the surface, better sunlight underwater and cleaner ripples at shallow angles.

28 October 2026

  • Added Home storage, setting up, repairing, resting in and packing up your Home, plus placing and taking up chests, in Survival on servers.
  • Improved water, with better depth and clarity, calmer lakes and smoother light patterns underwater.
  • Added new icons for hand tools, and corrected how tools and swords are held and swung in first person.
  • Fixed gaps showing in held sleeves at wide fields of view.
  • Fixed world textures appearing black on OpenGL graphics.
  • Fixed carried items and Creative choices being lost when a world you host stopped or was reopened.

27 October 2026

  • Added health and recovery, eating, TNT and dynamite on servers, all confirmed by the server and shared by everyone.
  • Added crafting, drinking, harvesting, block building, paid furniture and chest transfers on servers. Each waits for the server to confirm before items change.
  • Changed the Esc menu: Settings is split into groups, Controls opens the key bindings editor, and First steps can be hidden or reopened.
  • Changed quick slots to show the selection with a mint mark and the current item in small text at the bottom left.
  • Improved how guns and tools look in first person, with corrected grips and smoother aiming.
  • Fixed the fishing line coming off when you change what you hold.

26 October 2026

  • Added dropped items on servers: everyone sees them, and they are kept when the world is saved.
  • Added Survival melee, bows, rifles, rock throws and eggs on servers. Animals drop loot for everyone, and arrows cost real ammunition.
  • Fixed animals killed by bows, explosions and shells dropping incomplete loot.
  • Fixed remapped controls being overwritten when a key clashed with the item drop key.
  • Fixed collectible labels being hidden behind decorative plants.

25 October 2026

  • Added sitting on placed chairs. Press Space or right click to stand.
  • Added choosing the frame and panel wood of a chair or table before you place it.
  • Added the Furniture hammer for Survival. It opens a Carpentry workbench for paid chairs and tables, and plans can be bound to quick slots.
  • Added changing the woods of a placed chair or table in place with the furniture hammer.
  • Changed building so blocks, blueprints and doors cannot overlap placed furniture. A message now explains why a door will not close.
  • Added wooden doors in every wood, with plain and panelled designs in small and wide sizes. Held doors and previews now match the placed door.
  • Added placing, moving and undoing chairs and tables for Creative players on servers. Furniture appears for everyone who joins.
  • Added shared wildlife on servers. Everyone sees the same animals, and Creative removal and egg hatching work for all players.
  • Changed pine trees to a darker needle foliage texture.
  • Changed bushes to low, dense blocky foliage, and smoothed the rainbow cube and title on the main menu.

24 October 2026

  • Added chairs and tables in Build. Place them on supported ground with right click, turn with R, take one up with left click or Shift+left click to move it.
  • Fixed furniture help text covering the hotbar, stock labels covering Survival meters and hover outlines being hard to see on wood.
  • Changed the start menu to a centred card with the rainbow cube and the name qiqi. Continue is greyed out when there is no world to resume.
  • Changed Worlds so you select a world to see its preview, then press Play world. Deleting a world now needs a three-second hold on the selected save.
  • Added a Structure workshop to the main menu, a library of saved structures you can open, rename, duplicate, delete or create to build in a flat daylight workshop.
  • Changed dusk and night to be less colourful and slightly cooler, while staying easy to see. Daylight is unchanged.
  • Fixed LAN hosts being unable to switch their own game mode, and flying carrying on after the server confirmed a mode change.
  • Fixed textures on distant terrain being turned a different way from nearby terrain.
  • Changed many animals, including the toucan, penguin, swan, bear, otter, skunk and bat, to simpler, clearer models whose feet stay planted as they walk.

23 October 2026

  • Added N in Creative to switch between half-metre Detail building and whole blocks, so fine building no longer needs Shift while flying. The key can be changed in Controls.
  • Changed the blobfish, cockroach, snapping turtle, mantis shrimp, emu and bald eagle to simpler, clearer models whose feet stay planted as they walk.
  • Fixed the raccoon's tail rings, scraping paws and jumping ears, and platypuses not swimming properly in water.

22 October 2026

  • Changed many animals to simpler, clearer models, including the goat, zebra, giraffe, gorilla, orca, Komodo dragon and moose, and made small eyes easier to see.
  • Added blinking eyes to many birds and primates and livelier motion: a roadrunner's crest rises in alarm, an elephant's trunk curls over the ground and startled fish dart away.
  • Fixed fox legs passing through steps, bird collision not matching their new shapes, and Komodo dragon, gorilla and kangaroo feet on the ground.
  • Changed grass block and forest soil sides to show plain soil under an uneven grassy edge, and darkened jungle bark.
  • Changed the album covers on the Now Playing card to six new original pictures.
  • Fixed the game's graphics failing to start on NVIDIA computers that use OpenGL.
  • Fixed the last messages from a server sometimes being lost when the server closed the connection.

21 October 2026

  • Changed every remaining block texture to original artwork and redrew many: glass no longer looks like ice, bamboo is a living green, and thatch, sand, bark and soils look more like themselves.
  • Fixed thin stems, petals and grass blades thinning out or vanishing at a distance.
  • Changed many animal models: the crab, leafcutter ant and other small creatures were rebuilt and made large enough to spot, and faces, eyes and tails are easier to see.
  • Changed fleeing four-legged animals to gallop or bound, and made heads nod, tails sway and feet stay planted on steps as animals walk.
  • Fixed flickering patches on animal models and resting snakes, seals and turtles floating above the ground.
  • Fixed some worlds getting stuck on the loading screen when entering them.
  • Changed the names of many songs and two albums to fit the game's own world.

20 October 2026

  • Added an optional 1024-chunk Horizon setting that reaches about 16 km, double the previous maximum. It is demanding, so lower it if the game runs slowly.
  • Changed music to follow where you are, with different songs for menus, credits, weather, caves, the sea, building and time of day, plus quiet gaps and a short Now Playing card.
  • Added abstract voxel album covers that appear on the Now Playing card.
  • Improved music playback: songs now crossfade when you skip, fade out when music is switched off, and play in full stereo.
  • Changed the look of bark, end grain, ice, stone, rock, gravel, leaves and many other natural blocks with new original textures that are easier to tell apart.
  • Added new original textures for duckweed, roots, bamboo, ferns, kelp, seagrass and red, gold and blue coral.
  • Added finer detail to many creature textures.
  • Changed the cave centipede to a new, simpler model and gave the butterfly thinner antennae.
  • Fixed coat markings on reptiles, snakes, whales, gulls, turkeys, bald eagles and mantis shrimp so both sides of the animal match.

19 October 2026

  • Added /plot chat commands on servers to claim land, trust builders and check boundaries. Claims are saved with the world and you get a private notice when protected land changes.
  • Added a coloured operator console to the dedicated server, with a plain-text mode for scripts.
  • Fixed LAN worlds being unreachable from other devices when a VPN picked the wrong network address.
  • Changed building on servers so each build request is applied whole rather than partly.
  • Fixed Creative Undo and Redo shortcuts being read as flight toggles while flying.
  • Added new original textures for leaves, bark, end grain and boards, including separate birch and pine looks and redrawn oak, alder, acacia and fruitwood boards.
  • Added new original cactus, dry shrub and reed textures, and toned down the colours of turf, earth, moss and clay.
  • Improved loading of nearby and distant terrain, especially on computers with few CPU cores.

18 October 2026

  • Changed nights to be darker and cooler, with lamps still useful, and softened cloud shadows with distance.
  • Added occasional windblown leaves drifting from autumn trees in Fast and Cinematic. Reduced motion hides them.
  • Added quiet interface sounds for hovering controls, opening and closing the inventory, and refused actions. They follow the UI volume slider.
  • Changed animal calls to follow the animal as you or it moves, shifting in direction and loudness during the call.
  • Added a Restore removed button to the Journal so the last deleted place can be brought back.
  • Added Undo and Redo step counts and shortcuts to the Creative Build tab, and made Redo steadier in flight.
  • Changed movement through leaves to half speed, including Creative flight.
  • Fixed the camera seeing through leaves and stone when it sits inside them.
  • Fixed map travel, server teleports and respawn carrying over old momentum or posture.
  • Fixed LAN world discovery giving up when it could not start, and added the address and port to discovered worlds.
  • Changed the look of clay, sand, sandstone, mud, soil, gravel, ice, snow, ores, logs and turf with calmer, more readable original textures.
  • Fixed visible colour seams between faces of coastal rock blocks.
  • Improved performance by skipping distant terrain that is hidden from view.

17 October 2026

  • Added a Controls editor where you can rebind keys. It warns about duplicate keys and can reset everything to the defaults.
  • Added separate Music, Effects, Ambience and UI volumes, Hold or Toggle for sprint, sneak and crawl, and a UI scale from 75 to 200 percent.
  • Added High contrast and Reduce motion options, Low to Cinematic graphics presets, and a Find box to search the settings.
  • Added crosshair options for shape, size, colour and opacity, and a notice when the game cannot play sound.
  • Added an optional First steps card, a death screen that names the cause and lets you respawn when ready, and a pickup feed.
  • Added low-resource warnings on the HUD and a Screenshot action (F10) that saves pictures to your Pictures folder.
  • Added a create-world dialog with name, seed, mode and generator, rename and duplicate for saved worlds, playtime in the Worlds list and a key Help page.
  • Added keyboard control of menus with Ctrl+Tab, accented letters in text, and a recovery dialog when a saved world cannot be read.
  • Changed the main menu background to a wide isometric overview of your world with soft shadows and haze.
  • Added a craft queue in Survival with progress and a Stop queue button, and crafting lists show how many more ingredients you need.
  • Changed the rifle, its rounds, TNT and red lanterns so they no longer need the rare Glow crystal; charcoal and paper screens are used instead.
  • Added a reed fishing rod you cast and reel in with right click, and farm animals that gather in groups and rest at night.
  • Changed bamboo to solid stalks, and mining ground now also gathers the flowers, ferns and stalks rooted in it.
  • Fixed doors swinging or shutting through people and animals, and fixed saved positions being moved needlessly.
  • Added a Show on map button to the Journal, and walk-in cave entrances with limestone stalactites and stalagmites in new worlds.
  • Improved sailing with bow spray, a gentle heel in crosswinds and a boat display of speed, sail trim and heading. Weather now continues when a world is reloaded.
  • Fixed hollow-looking plant icons, held plants and rocks, washed-out crystals and water depth under ice.
  • Improved distant trees so they keep their leafy shape instead of turning into simple blocks.

16 October 2026

  • Changed grass, leaf and water colours to blend smoothly with the local climate, near and far.
  • Added walking and climbing through tree leaves: Space climbs, Shift descends and releasing both holds your height. Trunks and branches stay solid.
  • Added an optional chat word filter you control with /chatfilter. It starts switched off.
  • Added world backups: use Create backup or Ctrl+B in the Worlds list to save a separate copy of a world.
  • Changed world handling: Continue reopens your last world, deleting needs a visible hold, and save or naming problems are now reported instead of being ignored.
  • Added Previous and Next controls to the credits, and the game now asks the desktop not to blank the screen while its window is in use.
  • Changed Survival mining so bare hands are slower on hard materials, and cutting reeds or bamboo now removes only the part above the cut. Fixed cracks on carved blocks.
  • Changed gun sights so handheld guns and vehicles share one crosshair, with a HULL marker for tanks, and aiming stays responsive on slow computers.
  • Changed Survival so heat and cold no longer harm you. Health, food, water and stamina are the only meters.
  • Fixed streams staying behind after their source is removed, and drinking from water making a sound when nothing happened.
  • Fixed thrown dynamite, armed throws at the throw limit, and water drag on arrows. Dynamite now sticks to surfaces until it goes off.
  • Fixed sprinting using stamina while pushed against a wall, and held sprint restarting itself when you are exhausted.
  • Fixed hits on animals to follow their posed bodies, and fitted cat collision heights to their shape.
  • Added keyboard control of the Home screen for choosing actions and moving items between your inventory and Home storage.
  • Fixed rough movement, camera and arrow flight far from the centre of a world. Worlds saved afterwards cannot be opened by older game versions.
  • Improved distant terrain loading on integrated graphics, and fixed stale terrain showing in deep shafts.
  • Fixed held blocks to show a complete cube with the right textures and a visible grip.
  • Fixed typing Chinese Pinyin in text fields on Linux X11.
  • Fixed a song that takes too long to load blocking the music; it is now reported and you can pick another.

15 October 2026

  • Changed tree leaves and bushes to look bushier, with fluffy leaf tufts on exposed canopies and fuller leafy bushes.
  • Changed rain to fade out as you climb through the lowest cloud layer and to stop above the clouds, and raised the cloud layers.
  • Changed the bow to be held on the right with both hands visible and a clearer aim.
  • Improved the loading screen: the whole cube and wordmark now appear centred on a darker background, with glow colours that follow the cube.
  • Simplified the main menu to the title and its buttons, and fixed menus overlapping their footer buttons in small windows.

14 October 2026

  • Changed the game logo and icons to an outlined pastel rainbow cube.
  • Fixed mining cracks disappearing when your aim briefly leaves the block you are mining.
  • Added scrolling in the Worlds list with the wheel, trackpad and Page Up / Page Down, so long lists of saved worlds are easy to browse.
  • Added a new loading screen with a rotating pastel rainbow cube.
  • Fixed gravel shores in new worlds showing regular repeating bands of cobblestone; older worlds are unchanged.

13 October 2026

  • Added fifteen survival milestones and saved progress.
  • Changed world saves to store more block types and survival milestones.
  • Added placing, opening and removing doors on servers.
  • Added a list of local hosted worlds and visible swings from other players.
  • Fixed hosted saves losing the owner's rest point or reporting success before saving finished.
  • Fixed removing a Journal pin deleting unrelated destinations.
  • Fixed door placement, respawning and undo overlapping open doors.
  • Fixed X to repeat the selected recipe. Mining now chips the struck face and shows growing cracks.
  • Fixed drinking through diagonal obstructions and losing ammunition when a shot cannot launch.
  • Changed held-item motion and made View bob also control walking sway.
  • Fixed world and structure searches, structure updates and sideways item icons.
  • Fixed terrain recovery after a loading failure and long waits while joining an unresponsive server.
  • Improved Survival mining so progress is kept when your aim briefly slips off a block, instead of starting again.
  • Added boards of their own for twelve more kinds of log, including oak, acacia and cypress, each made by splitting a log piece into four boards.
  • Changed the block placement preview to show the real texture scale and removed the outlines around the aimed block and valid placements. Refused placements still show red.
  • Changed arrows, rifle rounds and thrown items to pass through grass, flowers and other soft plants. Turf, trunks, leaves and walls still block them.
  • Fixed status messages being cut short with room to spare, and made the HUD backing plates and text colours more consistent.
  • Fixed the map briefly showing the previous world when you switch worlds.
  • Fixed doors on servers sometimes refusing to shut right after you walk through them.
  • Changed hosted worlds to report why a save failed or is taking too long, and to keep running so you can make room and try again.

12 October 2026

  • Added usable wooden doors and chests, with opening and closing sounds.
  • Changed doors to swing smoothly away from the opener while keeping their full size.
  • Added blueprint capture, movable previews and building from saved structures.
  • Added names, preview pictures and search to the structure library.
  • Fixed saved selections, water restoration on undo and blueprint material costs.
  • Added a flat creative workshop. Older workshops keep their existing builds.
  • Added favourite worlds and pictures of saved worlds.
  • Added a Multiplayer menu for joining servers and hosting a world on the local network.
  • Fixed hosted saving of the owner's inventory, tools, chests and boats.
  • Added Escape to cancel joining and fixed server edits damaging whole doors and chests.
  • Changed the inventory to an item grid and added a feed of gathered materials.
  • Changed the map marker and smoothed map scrolling. Fixed sky showing through distant ground.
  • Added marble building blocks and simpler block names.
  • Changed fish and whale swimming and added gentle cruising for whales, orcas and sharks.
  • Fixed seasons changing survival temperature and walls allowing drinking through them.
  • Added hand and block swings and improved mining, water-entry and impact sounds.

11 October 2026

  • Added blush plaster, rose boards and fuchsia glazed tile.
  • Changed the target card and crosshair, and added adjustable Speed FOV and Damage bob.
  • Changed fox and maned wolf proportions and fixed elephant knees.

10 October 2026

  • Changed 32 common textures to original artwork.

8 October 2026

  • Added source-install scripts for Linux, macOS and Windows.

6 October 2026

  • Fixed respawning at blocked rest points, drinking reach and dynamite floating after losing support.
  • Fixed invalid camera angles and oversized windows.
  • Improved server trust-error messages.
  • Changed snow leopard, seal and maned wolf models and fish swimming.

5 October 2026

  • Added player chat and returning from a server to a local world.
  • Fixed joining, refused building edits and preserving final edits when leaving a server.
  • Fixed water outside save boundaries and missing server-save error messages.
  • Changed several animal models, including horses, elephants, sharks and birds.
  • Fixed animal feet sliding during stops and starts and added breathing and blinks to hoofed animals.

4 October 2026

  • Added saved-world search, held confirmation before deletion and clearer map markers.
  • Added the first multiplayer movement and shared building.
  • Changed local and multiplayer movement for smoother camera motion.
  • Fixed loading invalid world edits and saving when a server stops.
  • Fixed terrain failing to resume loading and improved nearby loading while flying.
  • Added distinct swimming, crawling and walking motions for more animals.
  • Changed several animal models and coats, including foxes, bears, birds and butterflies.

1 October 2026

  • Added inventory workspaces, creative brushes, home storage and expedition records.
  • Added a craftable sailing boat with moving sails, a walkable deck and saved position.

30 September 2026

  • Fixed terrain transitions, ice, cactus joins and excavated structures while exploring.
  • Added a longer, 512-chunk view-distance option.

28 September 2026

  • Added animated Study Grove scenes, weather, music and session cues.
  • Changed loading feedback, trees, ice spires, leaf colours and cloud shadows.
  • Fixed animals standing on steps, horizon seams and lighting on edited structures.

26 September 2026

  • Added biome and landmark finding, ambience, swimming, crawling and third-person views.
  • Changed mountains, islands, biome transitions, lighting and water.

24 September 2026

  • Changed terrain rendering and weather.

23 September 2026

  • Fixed sun glare, night visibility and noisy terrain textures.

18 August 2026

  • Changed building to use half-metre pieces and added more cooking, glass and material recipes.
  • Changed lighting settings and improved leaves, clouds and underwater light.
  • Fixed wave foam and cracks between water surfaces.

17 August 2026

  • Fixed distorted terrain and moving sea surfaces far from the starting area.
  • Added more varied branching shapes to trees.

16 August 2026

  • Added the first sandbox with terrain, trees, gentle survival and an inventory.

About this list

Selected base-game changes from 16 August 2026 to 8 November 2026. Dates follow the recorded history; they are not numbered releases. Early entries sometimes group several changes.
